segments.text: Rachel is the draw at the pub named Korogaru Ringotei. She acts like an older sister of Cliff, Shilphy and Eleanor, and she is a favorite with regular customers. She hates the royalty and the nobility, so Leticia keeps Leticia's social status secret for her.

segments.text: Eleanor is a childhood friend of Cliff and Shilphy, and is a knight who guards Leticia. She is good at swordsmanship, and she regrets that Cliff abandoned the swordsmanship. She is a daughter of a dressmaker, and she is also good at sewing.

segments.text: Leticia is the princess of Symphonia. Cliff rescues her by accident when she flees from her guards. She starts to work at the pub Korogaru Ringotei. She gives the false name Leticia Apple when she meets someone who doesn't know she is a princess.

Shilphy is Cliff's younger sister. She is a probationary sister at a church run by her parents, and she handles the church alone because her parents are away on propagation. She also teach schoolwork to children in the slums, and they like her very much.
